params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: question  Priority: P3
Summary: the garage asks whether the platform still spends a quarter of a remove.bg credit per photo, because their monthly credits ran out. The answer is yes per call, but a photo can cost more than one call.

Source: Portal mail:16 (a forwarded remove.bg "100% of your monthly credits used" notice).

## Answer

- The platform asks remove.bg for `size=preview` (`App\Http\Helpers\Photo::old_remove_background`, unchanged). remove.bg bills a preview image, up to 0.25 megapixel, at 0.25 credit; the balance can carry fractions. So one call is still a quarter credit.
- A photo is not always one call. A platform copy of a shared vehicle (`ProcessImage` with `duplicate`) is its own call, next to the dealer's own-photo background when they ask for one, and #990 shows one own photo getting two platform copies on the same file. The bulk action "all photos that still have a background" skips photos that already had their turn, so a refusal is not retried.
- The 2026-09-24 finding measured 443 calls against roughly 90 credits, consistent with 0.25 per call plus normal dealer activity in the same hours.
- The remove.bg subscription credits do not carry over month to month; pay-as-you-go credits do, but remove.bg says unused pay-as-you-go credits expire on 1 December 2026 when the service moves to Canva. Buying a large stock now is therefore not useful either way; see the migration issue #1004.

Nothing to change in code for this question. The exact month's spend is visible in the Koppelingen panel (remove.bg saldo from the daily smoke test) and in `stocklist:smoke removebg` on the box.
params.title: Does the platform still spend a quarter credit per remove.bg photo?
